title: Innovation in Insurance: Custodian Wins our Award in Nigeria
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html:
Custodian and Allied PLC, winner of the 2014 CFI.co award for ‘Most Innovative Insurance Company, Nigeria’, provides good evidence of this important characteristic with the recent launch of a mobile application that guides the customer through the complexities of the complete insurance cycle.

Innovation in risk management is evidence too and the insurer has a good response time record in respect of claims payment.

There is an attitude at Custodian of seeking out innovation to drive the best possible methods of service delivery.

The Judging Panel was also impressed with this company’s highly innovative approach and intelligent actions to encourage sustainability and described Custodian as a most thoughtful corporate citizen.
